scope: Independent image-only capture correctness, not feature acceptance or implementation review
inspection_method: Opened every individual capture PNG through view_image; 16 of 16 inspected. Read only AGENTS.md and capture inventory metadata; no game implementation inspection or modification.
identity_note: All images identify Tess / level 54 / Mirejaw via HUD. No human trainer can be independently named from image alone. Frame pass evaluates readable active/opponent creatures for the named HUD encounter.
summary: Camera starts inside/against geometry, briefly obtains useful framing, then loses the opponent and repeatedly becomes obstructed by terrain or creature close-ups.
Only the Tess/Mirejaw first opponent has images; no evidence for other requested named fights or additional opponents.
All six explicitly tagged tell stills have framing or world-tell occlusion problems. Incoming text is legible, but world telegraph footprint/direction is not reliably visible.

Primary opponent/player HUD text is generally readable; the team list is very faint in several images. Ability prompts visibly show mouse icons and F/C keys, so controller-specific prompt presentation is not evidenced.

Visible creatures and humans have detailed textured meshes; no obvious primitive placeholder creature is seen. Obstructed frames cannot verify hidden assets. Magenta strips appear as effects; their asset provenance cannot be determined from stills.
Lighting is adequate in unobstructed images. Wall-facing later frames lose world readability from framing rather than a demonstrated overall exposure issue.
